exports: pub fn quote_masks(quote_mask: u64, backslash_mask: u64, valid_len: u8, carry: &mut ScanCarry) -> Result<QuoteMasks>
test_vectors: Explicit delimiter, escaped quote, and string-content masks inside and outside strings.
Empty blocks with overlapping padding bits and all four canonical incoming carry combinations.
Exhaustive sequences of ordinary bytes, quotes, and backslashes through length eight against an independent backward-run-count oracle.
Every valid length from zero through 64 with overlapping high padding bits ignored before validation.
Isolated quote and backslash at every bit position, including bit 63, for full and partial blocks.
Every preceding backslash run from zero through 63 and every split boundary, including inserted empty blocks.
Trailing backslash runs of every length from zero through 64 with all incoming parity and string states.
Full-width all-quote masks with all incoming carry combinations.
String and odd backslash carry across multiple full blocks followed by escaped and closing quotes.
Every byte value between a backslash and quote, covering reset behavior, invalid syntax, controls, and non-UTF-8 bytes.
Every oversized u8 length from 65 through 255, including simultaneous invalid carry and overlap errors.
Noncanonical carry values 2, 3, 255, 256, the high bit, and u64::MAX, including empty blocks.
Live quote/backslash overlap at every position with unchanged complete carry on errors.
Opaque UTF-8 tail bytes and out-of-range UTF-8 tail length preserved on success and failure.
